meaning.zh:
“高贵的血统” 或 “贵族血统”。

“Blue blood” 这个短语起源于古代西班牙贵族，他们皮肤白皙，手腕处的血管显得特别蓝，因此被形容为 “蓝血”。随时间推移，这个短语被沿用下来，用来形容那些有贵族或者显赫家族背景的人。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the ancient Spanish nobility, who had very fair skin, making their veins appear prominently blue, leading to the term "blue blood". Over time, this phrase has been used to describe individuals with noble or aristocratic heritage.

lines.en: She always acts like she has *blue blood*, but she is just an ordinary person.
lines.zh: 她总表现得像是有贵族血统，其实她只是普通人。

lines.en: The family claims to have *blue blood* dating back centuries.
lines.zh: 这个家族声称有可以追溯到几个世纪前的贵族血统。

lines.en: Even though he has *blue blood*, he prefers to live a simple life.
lines.zh: 尽管他有贵族血统，他更喜欢过简单的生活。
